_status: FROZEN before any SACE or ORA run (Task A8). Do not edit after results exist.

clinical_config.sace: run_sace_layers on raw_counts layer; spotwise_profiles_init=None; antibody_data = raw antibody counts aligned to GEX spots

marker_gene_removal.rule: gene symbols of ALL antibodies in the REAL profile dictionary, '-1' suffix stripped; removed from the candidate list in EVERY variant (including scrambled_dict)

specificity.layer_definition: per-type per-gene mean over spots of SACE allocation E_x[:, t, g] (conserved: sums over types to the mean raw count)
specificity.expressed_gene: sum over types of layer means >= min_mean (specimen-level mean raw count per spot)
specificity.score: log2((mean_t + pseudocount) / (mean of the other types' layer means + pseudocount))
specificity.ora_background: all expressed genes of the specimen (same min_mean rule), uppercase symbols

min_layer_abundance.rule: a (specimen, type) pair is evaluable only if mean QP proportion of that type over spots >= threshold, using the REAL QP proportions for every variant

ora.tool: gseapy.enrich (offline hypergeometric ORA, local GMT, explicit background); NOT Enrichr server combined score
ora.library_download: gseapy 1.1.5 get_library(organism=Human, min_size=0, max_size=2000), written to GMT sorted by term, description column 'na'

pass_rule.definition: a (specimen, type, library) PASSES if at least one of the top-k significant terms (adjusted P < adj_p_threshold, ranked by adjusted P ascending, ties by term name) maps (term_mapping.yaml) to the lineage of the type
pass_rule.type_level_pass: a (specimen, type) PASSES if it passes in at least one of the two libraries (per-library rates also reported)
pass_rule.pass_rate: evaluable (specimen,type) pairs that pass / evaluable pairs, pooled over specimens, per variant; also per type and per specimen

variants.spot_permuted_marker: QP props with rows permuted by a Sattolo cyclic permutation (no fixed points, row multiset preserved, spatial alignment broken); init_method=marker, real dictionary, real coords
variants.uniform_marker: every spot has proportion 1/T for every type; init_method=marker, real dictionary
variants.scrambled_marker: real QP props; dictionary marker lists cyclically assigned to other type names via a Sattolo permutation of type names; init_method=marker

seeds.per_specimen: base + index of specimen in the list above

null_check.arm_supported_iff: real pass rate >= min_real_pass_rate AND for EVERY null in the arm: null pass rate <= real pass rate - margin

verdicts.SUPPORTED: both arms supported: claim 'check distinguishes a correct deconvolution from a badly wrong one' may be made
verdicts.PROP_ARM_ONLY: prop arm supported, marker arm not: only 'proportion-weighted profiles carry lineage-specific signal beyond spatially shuffled/uniform proportions' may be said; no general correct-vs-wrong claim
verdicts.NOT_SUPPORTED: otherwise: the correct-vs-wrong claim is DROPPED and only what holds is reported
